criteria.text: Diagnosis of pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH, WHO Group 1).
Patient is an adult, age 18 years or older (approval criterion 1).
Prescribed by or in consultation with a cardiologist or pulmonologist (approval criterion 2).
WHO Group 1 PAH confirmed by right heart catheterization (approval criterion 3).

Trial and failure, contraindication, or intolerance to oral PAH therapies from at least two different categories, each for at least 60 days: PDE5 inhibitor, endothelin receptor antagonist (if not pregnant), guanylate cyclase stimulator (approval criterion 4).
Patient is not currently taking and will not take Uptravi together with a prostanoid/prostacyclin analogue (approval criterion 5).
No concomitant strong CYP2C8 inhibitor (e.g. gemfibrozil), or provider attests benefits of treatment outweigh risks (denial criterion 2).

notes: Partial encoding from Alaska Medicaid Uptravi Criteria Version 1; Original 12/19/2022; Approval 01/20/2023; Effective 03/01/2023. Source typo "sekexipag" corrected to selexipag.
Encoded: closed WHO Group 1 PAH indication, approval criteria 1-5 and denial criterion 2. Denial criterion 1 is failure to meet approval criteria.

Oral step therapy is a single attestation: trial and failure, contraindication, or intolerance in at least two distinct eligible categories, each for at least 60 days. Categories: PDE5 inhibitor, endothelin receptor antagonist (only if not pregnant), guanylate cyclase stimulator. Two drugs from one category do not satisfy this requirement. Pregnancy is not a separate blanket exclusion.
Cautions (notes only): monitor for pulmonary edema in patients with PVOD (pulmonary veno-occlusive disease).
Duration (notes only): initial approval 6 months; reauthorization 12 months with chart notes indicating positive clinical response to Uptravi treatment.
Quantity (notes only): #60 tablets per 30 days up to 3200 mcg/day oral OR #60 vials per 30 days up to 3600 mcg/day IV; HCPCS J3490. max_units is null; quantity is not evaluated.
Documentation verification, cautions, duration, reauthorization and quantity require manual review; this pack remains partial. Linked alternatives require their own criteria review.
